name: Hollow Memory Thief
lore: A thin assassin that steals the memory of a Titan’s last tactic, forcing the Titan to adapt instead of repeat.
visualDescription: Slender black blade-limbed figure, empty face veil, stolen glyphs orbiting its fingers, quiet white eye-cracks.
mapBehavior: Targets repeated player actions and disrupts cooldown rhythm.

scaling.campaign: Fixed mission bands; old wins should become easier as Titan level and gear rise.
scaling.eliteRemix: +12% hp, +10% damage, +1 mechanic layer, +2 tactical AI priority.
scaling.endgame: Dynamic scaling is capped at player effective level +8; adds mechanics before raw hp.
scaling.levelFormula: hp = baseHp * (1 + 0.045 * missionLevel); damage = baseDamage * (1 + 0.035 * missionLevel), capped by tier budget

aiProfile.counterplayWindow: Every major action has a telegraph or setup turn unless spawned as a minor swarmer.

balanceNotes: Harder solo tuning: Major BRUTE pressures one active Titan through behavior first, stats second; threatWeight 2.0 controls encounter budgets.
